headings: PUMPKIN SPICE MUSHROOM SCENTED CANDLE SET (PACK OF 5)

jsonld_raw.name: PUMPKIN SPICE MUSHROOM SCENTED CANDLE SET (PACK OF 5)
jsonld_raw.description:
Small scented candles with shapes inspired by different types of mushrooms.

PUMPKIN SPICE | An invitation to deep memories. Warm and surprising spices that reveal a delicious sweet pumpkin accord intertwined with creamy notes of sandalwood and cashmere.

Notes:
Top notes: Citrus, Nutmeg
Heart notes: Pumpkin.
Base notes: Cinnamon, Spices, Cashmeran, Dry wood

The set includes 5 units with different designs.
